segments.title: Lethal Company Mod Installation & Technical Troubleshooting
segments.notes: Case Blackwell attempts to install 'More Company' mod for expanded lobby size; repeated crashes, reinstallations, and folder management consume the opening hour with Tim and John assisting via Discord.

segments.title: First Successful Lobby & Initial Planetary Runs
segments.notes: Mod functional at 32-player capacity; Case, Tim, John, and Kendall (as 'Jake Halston' and 'Pug') land on Experimentation, recover scrap, suffer first deaths to fall damage and darkness.

segments.title: Assurance & Fire Exit Exploration
segments.notes: Crew purchases flashlights and walkie-talkies; turret encounters, locked doors, and nighttime monsters claim multiple lives; quota reached but crew pushes for surplus.

segments.title: Mod Conflict Resolution & Expanding Roster
segments.notes: Case restarts lobby repeatedly to accommodate 'Big Lobby' vs 'More Company' mod mismatch; Christian, Bill, Miracle, Exterminator, Ash, Fancy, Rancid, Sinister Dev, Hostway, Tanae attempt joins; Kendall departs for shoot.

segments.title: Mass Lobby Gameplay & Mod Migration
segments.notes: 32-player lobby stabilizes on 'More Company' mod; extended runs on Experimentation, Assurance, Vow, March; spider, bracken, thumper, and giant encounters; Case coordinates from ship terminal.

segments.title: Hype Train Activation & Jetpack Catastrophe
segments.notes: Chat triggers Hype Train at 05:01:14; Case purchases 70%-off jetpack, immediately crashes into ocean during test flight; crew sells surplus, buys pro flashlights and lockpicks.

segments.title: Final Runs, Glitch & Raid Handoff
segments.notes: Offense moon run yields employee promotions; dog monster killed by Ash with yield sign; ship glitches on departure; Case raids Tenet at 05:51:05.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors impromptu Lethal Company marathon, manages 32-player modded lobby, coordinates ship terminal, whispers to avoid mic bleed with Kendall in same room.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-hosts gaming session from same room, plays as 'Jake Halston', departs mid-stream for friend's shoot, returns briefly before shower.

lore_notes.fact: Case and Kendall are cohabiting and planning move to ADU with separate gaming setups.
Case's Discord community 'Cream Team' coordinates modded Lethal Company sessions.
Case promotes as 'employee' rank after surviving extended session.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News anchor Case Blackwell abandons the news desk for a five-hour Lethal Company marathon, wrangling a 32-player modded lobby through repeated technical failures, mod conflicts, and escalating planetary casualties. Executive Producer Pepito is notably absent as Case manages the broadcast solo from the ship terminal, whispering to avoid audio bleed with cohabiting contributor Kendelle. The session culminates in a chat-triggered Hype Train, a disastrous 70%-off jetpack test flight, and a glitched departure before Case raids Tenet.
